--- alter_table_alter_column_with_on_update_default.sql
ALTER TABLE foo ALTER COLUMN bar TIMESTAMP NOT NULL ON UPDATE (pending_commit_timestamp()) DEFAULT (pending_commit_timestamp())

--- AST

  Name: &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 12,
        NameEnd: 15,
        Name:    "foo",
      },
    },
  },
  TableAlteration: &ast.AlterColumn{
    Alter: 16,
    Name:  &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 29,
      NameEnd: 32,
      Name:    "bar",
    },
    Alteration: &ast.AlterColumnType{
      Type: &ast.ScalarSchemaType{
        NamePos: 33,
        Name:    "TIMESTAMP",
      },
      Null:                47,
      NotNull:             true,
      OnUpdateDefaultExpr: &ast.ColumnOnUpdateDefaultExpr{
        OnUpdate: &ast.OnUpdate{
          On:     52,
          Rparen: 89,
          Expr:   &ast.CallExpr{
            Rparen: 88,
            Func:   &ast.Path{
              Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 63,
                  NameEnd: 87,
                  Name:    "pending_commit_timestamp",
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
        DefaultExpr: &ast.ColumnDefaultExpr{
          Default: 91,
          Rparen:  126,
          Expr:    &ast.CallExpr{
            Rparen: 125,
            Func:   &ast.Path{
              Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 100,
                  NameEnd: 124,
                  Name:    "pending_commit_timestamp",
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
